when you are asked to create a pull request, please follow these instructions:
1. **Create a new branch**: Always create a new branch for your changes.
  Use a descriptive name that reflects the changes you are making and match the convention used in the project:
  dev/etty/[description] or dev/etty/[issue-number]-[description].
  ask me what the ticket number. at the pr title add ticket number and description.
2. **Make your changes**: Implement your changes in the new branch.
3. **Test your changes**: Ensure that your changes work as expected and do not break any existing functionality.
4. **Create a pull request**: Once you are satisfied with your changes, create a pull request to merge your changes into the main branch.
